blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.

blocks.note: كم هي المدّة التي سيبقون فيها هنا؟
سامي راغب في أن تبقى ليلي.

blocks.text: Why does he want to stay?

sentences.t: You should stay back.
Sami is here to stay.
You stay with us now.
He didn't stay there.
How long did you stay?
They can stay with us.
Why do they stay here?
Ziri didn't stay here.
I can't stay long today.
How long will they stay?

sentences.t: Sami wants Layla to stay.

sentences.t: Why does he want to stay?
He didn't stay here long.
He wants you to stay here.
I don't want to stay here.
How long will you stay here?
Tom can stay if he wants to.
Sami should stay with Layla.
sentences.ar: يجب أن يبقى سامي مع ليلى.

sentences.t: Tom wants to stay with Mary.
I want to stay here with Tom.
They say that they won't stay.
I have only you, stay with me.
I'd like to stay here with you.
How long did you stay in Canada?

They had to stay at home all day.
sentences.ar: كان عليهم البقاء في المنزل طوال اليوم.

sentences.t: Where do you think we should stay?
sentences.ar: أين تظن أن علينا أن نمكث؟

sentences.t: I told them to stay in their room.
sentences.ar: لقد قلت لهم أن يبقوا في غرفتهم.

sentences.t: Sami asked Layla to stay away from him.
sentences.ar: طلب سامي من ليلى أن تبقى بعيدة عنه.

sentences.t: You had better stay away from work today.
sentences.ar: كان من الأحسن لو تركت العمل اليوم.
